title: VIP-COP: Context Optimization for Tabular Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.12904v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for in-context learning on structured data, enabling direct prediction on new tabular tasks without task-specific training. However, their effectiveness is constrained by context length limits, restricting application to medium-scale data and degrading performance when inference-time data exceed pretraining size distributions. Our work introduces VIP-COP, estimating the Value of Importance for Prediction of training examples and features for hard Context OPtimization for TFMs. Its explicit selection mechanism suppresses noise and isolates influential data, enabling the model to also benefit from data augmentation by prioritizing high-value augmented samples and features. VIP-COP is (i) fast, boosting performance often within minutes of optimization, based on an online KernelSHAP-based regression with iterative refinement, value-guided context sampling, and multi-fid

translated_title: VIP-COP：面向表格基础模型的上下文优化
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型（TFMs）已成为在结构化数据上进行上下文学习的强大范式，无需针对特定任务进行训练即可直接对新表格任务进行预测。然而，其有效性受到上下文长度限制的约束，这限制了其在中等规模数据上的应用，并且当推理时的数据规模超过预训练时的规模分布时，性能会下降。我们的工作提出了VIP-COP，通过估计训练样本和特征对预测的重要性价值，实现对TFMs的硬上下文优化。其显式选择机制能够抑制噪声并分离出有影响力的数据，使模型还能通过优先选择高价值的增强样本和特征而从数据增强中受益。VIP-COP具有以下特点：（i）快速，通常在几分钟的优化内即可提升性能，基于带迭代精炼的在线KernelSHAP回归、价值引导的上下文采样以及多保真度……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: VIP-COP通过估计训练样本和特征对预测的重要性价值来对表格基础模型进行硬上下文优化，能在几分钟内提升性能，突破上下文长度限制，并能借助数据增强中高价值样本和特征的优先选择进一步获益。
en_tdlr: VIP-COP performs hard context optimization for tabular foundation models by estimating the importance value of training examples and features, boosting performance within minutes while overcoming context length limits and prioritizing high-value augmented samples and features.
